title: Biased two point inequality
statement:
Let $p,\alpha,\beta,u,v\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $1<p<2$, $0<\alpha<\beta$, and $\alpha^p+\beta^p=1$. Set $r=(\alpha^p\beta^{2-p}-\alpha^{2-p}\beta^p)/(\alpha^2-\beta^2)$. Then
\[
(\alpha^p u+\beta^p v)^2+r\alpha^p\beta^p(u-v)^2\le\bigl(\alpha^p|u|^p+\beta^p|v|^p\bigr)^{2/p}.
\]
